message.minetorio.not_paired: The drill is not running: no matching Drill Head Base nearby.
message.minetorio.no_ore: The drill is waiting: the head is not on a patch ore block, or the base is not spinning.
message.minetorio.ore_left: Ore left to mine: %1$d ore blocks and %2$d raw ore (%3$d cycles)
minetorio.ponder.head_3x3.text_1: Build the head ring by ring from Drill Head blocks. The middle column stays empty: the rod will run there.
minetorio.ponder.head_3x3.text_2: Put a Drill Head Base block on top of the empty middle column and give it rotation from above.
minetorio.ponder.head_3x3.text_3: When the base spins, a rotating rod slides out of it down the middle column to the bottom of the head, right above the ore.
minetorio.ponder.head_5x5.text_1: Build the head ring by ring from Drill Head blocks. The middle column stays empty: the rod will run there.
minetorio.ponder.head_5x5.text_2: Put a Drill Head Base block on top of the empty middle column and give it rotation from above.
minetorio.ponder.head_5x5.text_3: When the base spins, a rotating rod slides out of it down the middle column to the bottom of the head, right above the ore.
minetorio.ponder.drill_3x3.text_1: Quarry drills work on ore patches. Build the head directly above the ore: the bottom of the middle column must touch the ore.
minetorio.ponder.drill_3x3.text_2: Build the head from Drill Head blocks in exactly this shape and leave the middle column empty.
minetorio.ponder.drill_3x3.text_3: Put a Drill Head Base on top of the head and give it rotation from above.
minetorio.ponder.drill_3x3.text_4: A rotating rod slides out of the base all the way down to the ore. It never breaks blocks.
minetorio.ponder.drill_3x3.text_5: Place the Quarry Drill Drive nearby and give it rotation from any side except its output. It needs 1024 SU at 32 RPM and yields 1 ore block and 1 raw ore every 5 minutes at 32 RPM; every extra 32 RPM multiplies that. When it starts, it pairs with the base until one of them is broken.
minetorio.ponder.drill_3x3.text_6: Place the drive with right-click to make the red-dot output face you, or while sneaking to face away. Ore goes into an adjacent chest or belt. Right-click the drive to see how much ore is left.
minetorio.ponder.drill_5x5.text_1: Quarry drills work on ore patches. Build the head directly above the ore: the bottom of the middle column must touch the ore.
minetorio.ponder.drill_5x5.text_2: Build the head from Drill Head blocks in exactly this shape and leave the middle column empty.
minetorio.ponder.drill_5x5.text_3: Put a Drill Head Base on top of the head and give it rotation from above.
minetorio.ponder.drill_5x5.text_4: A rotating rod slides out of the base all the way down to the ore. It never breaks blocks.
minetorio.ponder.drill_5x5.text_5: Place the Quarry Drill Drive nearby and give it rotation from any side except its output. It needs 1536 SU at 32 RPM and yields 2 ore blocks and 3 raw ore every 5 minutes at 32 RPM; every extra 32 RPM multiplies that. When it starts, it pairs with the base until one of them is broken.
minetorio.ponder.drill_5x5.text_6: Place the drive with right-click to make the red-dot output face you, or while sneaking to face away. Ore goes into an adjacent chest or belt. Right-click the drive to see how much ore is left.
